{{Quote|A Jedi sufficiently strong in the Force can be trained to produce a facsimile, but not true Sith lightning, which, unabated, has the power not only to incapacitate or kill, but to physically transform the victim. Force lightning requires strength of a sort only a Sith can command because we accept consequence and reject compassion. To do so requires a thirst for power that is not easily satisfied. The Force tries to resist the callings of ravenous spirits; therefore it must be broken and made a beast of burden. It must be made to answer one's will. But the Force cannot be treated deferentially. In order to summon and use lightning properly, you will someday have to be on the receiving end of its power, as a means of taking the energy inside yourself.|[[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]|<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
'''Force lightning''' was a well-known [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|ability]] used to blast dangerous electrical bolts, most often by practitioners of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], especially the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. The ability was commonly referred to as '''Sith lightning '''due to the affiliations of its typical users and manipulation of lightning.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

==Description==
{{Quote|Some possess raw elemental power; they can unleash storms of lightning from their fingertips&hellip;|[[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]|<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Force_lightning.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Namman Cha]] projects a Force spark.]]
Force lightning was an almost purely offensive and energy-based power that channeled Force energy down the user's limbs, hurling arcing bolts of electricity<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> from the wielder's fingertips or palms; Force lightning could be executed with either one or two hands.<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref><ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> Powerful discharges would branch out into dozens of smaller forks; thus, skilled practitioners could target several foes at once.<ref name="swe-betrayal">''[[Star Wars: Empire: Betrayal]]''</ref>  Sometimes, a Sith or Jedi might touch an enemy and send lightning through the hand into the foe.<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> Lightning was at times flashed around the eyes or fingertips as a sign of power.<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref><ref name="FOTJ1" />

The intensity varied based on a number of factors. Users skilled in controlling the intensity and force of their lightning could render a target unconscious with only a short burst, or kill a person instantly with a single, powerful blast. [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane's]] lightning, for example, would often electrocute his opponents to death on contact. [[Galen Marek]] was another Force-user who could channel lightning that would kill on contact. Both [[Kyle Katarn]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] could conjure lightning so powerful that not only would it instantly kill its target, it would also physically hurl them backwards. The latter's usage was also powerful enough to render anyone caught in it into charred husks if used to its full potency, as demonstrated by his execution of Headmaster [[Gentis]] for his [[Ghost Prison incident|military coup]] against him.<ref name="SWDV&GP">''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison]]''</ref> [[Subject 1138|Galen Marek's clone]] could temporally and Sidious were able to produce lightning at such intensity that it literally vaporized their targets.

The fact that it caused not only severe physical damage but also unbearable agony to the victim led to it being widely used as a form of [[Torture/Legends|torture]]. Sidious repeatedly assaulted his former apprentice, [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], as well as [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] with lightning,<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" /><ref name="Lawless">{{TCW|The Lawless}}</ref> and [[Darth Malak]] used it upon [[Bastila Shan]], having captured her aboard the [[Leviathan (Interdictor-class cruiser)|''Leviathan'']] and having brought her to [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]], where he converted her to the dark side.

[[File:Mighella_VS_Maul.jpg|thumb|right|220px|[[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Mighella]] subjects [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] to Force lightning.]]

Due to the fact that Force lightning was, at its core, simply electricity generated by the dark side, it could be grounded with any material that was resistant to electrical currents.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> Depending on the level of intensity, Force lightning could ground itself on an ignited [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], with no apparent ill effect on the lightsaber's operation.<ref name="Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref><ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref> However, some of the technique's most exceptionally powerful practitioners, were capable of producing blasts that contained enough kinetic energy to tear an ignited lightsaber from their opponent's grasp. One of the most notable examples of this was seen during the duel between Darth Sidious and Yoda, where Sidious disarmed the Jedi master with a particularly powerful lightning blast, forcing Yoda to use [[tutaminis]] to defend himself.<ref name="Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith" /> Powerful [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-siders]] were sometimes able to resist the attack, or even block the lightning completely. [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], with his [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] form [[Form VII/Legends|Vaapad]], could reflect the lightning back to its source with a "superconducting loop". It required tremendous effort on the reflector's part, however, as seen in Windu's battle with Palpatine; Windu was seemingly able to overcome Sidious's lightning. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was also able to deflect [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] lightning, with his lightsaber, without exerting much effort as well. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was also seen doing this against [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]], despite the fact that Starkiller's lightning was powerful enough to outright disintegrate his targets. Galen Marek was capable of creating a shield out of his lightning and could deflect even Palpatine's Force lightning back at him as to could Palpatine.

Force lightning could also be absorbed and redirected by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of sufficient skill; Yoda demonstrated this ability by both deflecting and absorbing the dark power during battles with Darth Sidious and Tyranus, using nothing more than his own two [[hand]]s.<ref name="Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith" /> Galen Marek was also able to block Palpatine's lightning with only his bare hands while walking towards him. Luke Skywalker attempted this, and succeeded for a short amount of time, before the Emperor's attack overwhelmed him.<ref name="rotjn">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref> [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] demonstrated great proficiency in this ability; he used his bare hands to absorb a [[Force lightning/Legends#Force_storm|very powerful barrage of Force Lightning]] from [[Darth Nyriss]] and then [[Force deflection/Legends|deflected]] it back at her, destroying her with her own power in the process.<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> The Force could also be used to simply [[Force deflection/Legends|deflect]] Force lightning without absorbing it, as demonstrated by Darth Tyranus during his initial engagement with Yoda.<ref name="AOTC" />

There was an advanced version of Force lightning which may have been used by Revan in the [[Jedi Civil War]] and [[Meetra Surik]] during the [[First Jedi Purge]], known as Force storm.<ref name="KotOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref><ref name="KotOR 2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> Galen Marek used this power on the giant [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] during his duel with [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] and she used it against him.<ref name=":1" />

On two occasions, Force lightning was conjured out of thin air, without needing to be fired from the living flesh of a Force-sensitive.<ref name="Star Wars 1998 22">[[Star Wars (1998) 22|''Star Wars'' (1998) 22]]</ref><ref name=":0">[[Legacy (2006) 35|''Legacy'' (2006) 35]]</ref>

==Effect of Force lightning==
{{Quote|The attempt on my life has left me scarred and deformed. But, I assure you, my resolve has never been stronger!|Palpatine|<ref name="Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith" />}}
Though the short-term effects of Force lightning are obvious, the sheer power invoked by its use could have insidious long-term effects, both on those subjected to its power and those who would wield it. It could deform the person being shocked and it could also lead to them being crippled. Prolonged exposure to intense electrical fields (such as a sustained current of Force lightning) caused most humanoids to experience sudden and massive [[calcification]] of their skeletal system; the abrupt drop in blood minerals provoked muscular micro-seizures all over the victim's body.<ref name="tab">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref> Intense enough doses of Force lightning will also have the victim having his or her skeletal system being seen through the body, as demonstrated with Darth Vader and Mace Windu. However, this does not impact the user if it is redirected at him or her. This is especially evident with Sidious shortly before his death, as despite being hit with Force lightning at an intensity great enough to cause Vader's skeleton to shine through his armor when picked up by Vader, he did not exhibit the same symptoms.

[[File:Windu-lightning-effects-2.png|thumb|left|250px|Mace Windu's skeletal system can be seen while being subjected to Darth Sidious' Force lightning barrage]]
Telltale symptoms included generalized muscle aches and double vision. A blood test or bioscan could be used to confirm the diagnosis.

Unless the victim received complete bed rest and appropriate medical treatment, the disorder would become chronic, lingering for years (barring timely [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] immersion). Luke Skywalker, who was diagnosed with the disorder by 4 ABY was confined to a hoverchair for his trip to [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] during the Ssi-Ruuk invasion, mere days after his near-fatal encounter with Sidious.<ref name="tab" />

It was thought that very intense use of Force lightning could drain the user physically, and possibly result in severe facial and body deformations. The deformities Sidious displayed after unleashing a barrage of Force lightning on Mace Windu, only to have it reflected back upon him by the Jedi Master's lightsaber is an example of this, although it was also implied that he was using the mask ability up to that point. Darth Plagueis also implied that the users' abilities with Force Lightning would grow even stronger when subjected to their own attack.

When Anakin Skywalker redeemed himself and killed the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], his [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|life support circuitry]] was critically damaged, leaving him a heavy and lifeless quadriplegic.<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" />

Besides draining the user's energy, Force lightning had the added drawback of occasionally charring the hand of the person who used it. When [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] flew into a rage underneath the ruins of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Yuuzhan'tar]] and attacked his [[Yuuzhan Vong]] pursuers with Force lightning, he later found that the blasts had burned charred holes in his palm.

Very powerful blasts of Force lightning could highlight and illuminate the victim's skeleton, as shown with Mace Windu, [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], and Darth Vader.<ref name="Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith" /><ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" />

For unknown reasons, Force lightning (together with its various variants, such as [[Electric Judgment]]) and [[Force net|Force Net]] were only known Force powers able to directly affect the Force-immune alien [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="SBS">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref>

==Use by Jedi==
[[File:Luke_Swarm_War.jpg|thumb|250px|Luke Skywalker utilizing Electric Judgement during the [[Swarm War]].]]
{{Quote|Force lightning. We had thought Skywalker's Jedi considered themselves above that.''"<br />"''We make exceptions.|[[Welk]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]]|<ref name="Dark Nest I: The Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>}}
Force lightning ability was not restricted to dark-siders. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and other light-siders who were strong of will and character ''could'' learn this power without falling to the dark side&mdash;but its use was viewed as inherently corrupting, and most Jedi Councils forbade its use. By contrast, the forebears of the Jedi, the Je'daii, openly and commonly used Force Lightning without seeing it as a moral or philosophical issue, though they did admit that there were safety risks and that this power was a weapon of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Bogan]].<ref name="Force Storm">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm]]''</ref><ref name="Force War">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi: Force War]]''</ref>

Some Jedi nonetheless refused to dismiss the natural power of this ability. [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], [[Meetra Surik]], [[Jolee Bindo]], [[Bastila Shan]], and [[Vrook Lamar]] were amongst its users during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the [[Jedi Civil War]] and the [[First Jedi Purge]]. [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] used this ability (which he called [[Electric Judgment]]) to subdue a criminal named [[Dreed Pommel|Pommel]], who had taken a hostage. Koon used Force lightning to knock Pommel out, yet claimed to have no plans to experiment with it in the future. Moreover, some Jedi peacekeepers refused to turn away from Force lightning, understanding it to be a useful tool in their duties.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force" /> Dooku also used this technique before his fall during the Battle of Galidraan.<ref name=":2" /> Aayla Secura was another Jedi who used this art.<ref name=":3" />

[[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] could also employ this power effectively, and used it against the [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] Jedi [[Volfe Karkko]]. [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]] also used Force lightning against the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].<ref name=":2">[[Dark Heart (short story)|Dark Heart {{C|short story}}]]</ref> [[Grand Master/Legends|Grandmaster]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] himself was capable of summoning force lightning in the form of Emerald Lightning.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: What Is a Sith Warrior?">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: What Is a Sith Warrior?|Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Who are the Jedi?]]''</ref> Jedi champions and soldiers of the light were known to often use the light side to unleash green lightning.<ref name=":3">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'' {{C|video game}}]]</ref>

[[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] utilized this Force power. Her killer, [[Galen Marek]], was an extremely skilled user of this Force power, even after his conversion to the light side.<ref name=":1">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' graphic novel]]</ref> He could kill foes with a single blast and was able to hit many adversaries at the same time. He was also able to deflect Force lightning with his lightsaber or even with his bare hands such as during the [[Battle on Death Star I]]. He could also charge objects and people with lightning and use them as improvised grenades, and to create a shield of lightning around his body to protect himself. Marek's [[Subject 1138|clone]] was even more proficient, being able to occasionally set stormtrooper armor on fire with the power.

Some members of the New Jedi Order such as Luke Skywalker (who also used the dark side version at times), Jacen Solo and [[Jaden Korr]] also used light side Force lightning known as "Emerald Lightning", or [[Electric Judgment]], but it remained somewhat controversial to some Jedi.<ref name="Empire's End 2">[[Empire's End 2|''Empire's End'' 2]]</ref><ref name="JK2">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref><ref name="JK: Jedi Academy">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref><ref name="Riptide">[[Riptide (novel)|''Riptide'']]</ref> Other Jedi practitioners of the dark side version of this power have been [[Relin Druur]], [[Kyp Durron]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] (in a black variant respectively), Kyle Katarn, [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] and Luke Skywalker. Luke Skywalker in particular was able to utilize a Emerald Lightning instantaneously kill his targets.<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref> The rogue Jedi Master [[Kenth Hamner]] used lightning on the Jedi he defeated during his rebellion against the Jedi Order, in order to make sure they could not swiftly awaken.<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>

==Force lightning users==
{{Quote|I've become more powerful than any Jedi. Even you.|[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], while firing Force lightning at him|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
[[File:MaladiLightning.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Darth Maladi]] blasts [[Deliah Blue]] and [[Jariah Syn]] with Force lightning.]]
Force lightning almost<ref name=":0" /> always required a living conduit for the energy to be channeled;<ref name="BoS" /> thus the suit-bound Darth Vader, despite being an immensely powerful Sith Lord, was never able to properly employ this ability, as any attempt to generate it carried the risk of shorting out his life support systems.<ref name="Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> In addition, Vader's life support systems were not well insulated, and the system's delicate circuitry was vulnerable to the damaging effects of Force lightning. This vulnerability would eventually contribute to his death.<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" />

[[Jorak Uln]], the former headmaster of the Sith Academy on Korriban who hid in the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] during the Jedi Civil War, would sometimes kidnap and torture Sith students. One of his favorite games was testing his captives on Sith philosophy, punishing their failure with Force lightning, often until they were killed.<ref name="KotOR" />

Darth Malak used Force lightning as a means of torture to turn Bastila Shan to the dark side. It was intended to give her a "taste" of the dark side's power, a technique that eventually succeeded, with her taking up this dark power alongside a role as Malak’s apprentice (though she later returned to the light side).<ref name="KotOR" />

[[File:TFUII-Force_Lightning.png|thumb|right|250px|The Force lightning skill.]]
The [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] Force Lightning was so powerful that he overwhelmed the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Revan, to a degree that [[Revan's mask]] started to melt into his skin. As Valkorion, he later employed this against both Darth Marr, killing him instantly, and his son Arcann, who was able to resist it, despite being severely burned. Arcann later used the same type of lightning against [[Alliance Commander|The Outlander]].<ref name="Revan" />

Darth Tyranus had an affinity for use of Force lightning; often to inflict punishment and occasionally personal delight. He also performed the technique in acts of defense in absence of his lightsaber. Dooku used the technique to incapacitate Anakin Skywalker during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. He also attempted the technique on [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who was able to block it with his lightsaber, and Master Yoda, who managed to [[Tutaminis|reflect and dispel the energy with his bare hands]]. In addition, Tyranus utilized this power to stabilize the heartbeat of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] after the Kaleesh's body was mangled in a shuttle crash.<ref name="The Eyes of Revolution">{{StoryCite|story=The Eyes of Revolution|book=Star Wars: Visionaries}}</ref>

[[File:BZZZZZZ.png|thumb|220x220px|Darth Sidious tortures Luke Skywalker after the latter refused to join him.]]

Darth Sidious was a master of the technique. He used Force lightning to punish Luke Skywalker for his refusal to join him, beginning with an agonizing but non-lethal quantity and working his way gradually upwards toward lethality. When Anakin Skywalker turned on the Emperor, Sidious used the lightning at a much higher intensity, which eventually killed him.<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" /> The Ysaana used white lightning, though Luke Skywalker found them to be weak due to their lack of training.<ref name="Dark Empire II 3">[[Dark Empire II 3|''Dark Empire II'' 3]]</ref>

Other Force-sensitives known to have used the power or its variants include:

==Variants of Force lightning==
===Electric Judgement===
Also known as [[Electric Judgment|Emerald Lightning]], this Light Side variant of Force Lightning was used by some Jedi Knights and Masters to launch green<ref name="TUF" /> or orange bolts to stun or kill their enemies. Unlike most other forms of Force Lightning, it was possible to fuel using feelings of justice or the normal method of using ones anger. [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] was a noted user of this technique.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force" />

===Hassat-durr===
[[Hassat-durr]] was a version of Force lightning that the Baran-Do Sages used, where white bolts could be conjured to fight or burn items. Moreover, it was not of the dark side.<ref name="FOTJ1">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref>

===Force shock===
[[File:Wracking_Energy.jpg|right|thumb|Force lightning could be used as the Wracking Energy, restricting target's movement.]]
'''Force shock''' was a Force power that allowed the user to create an energy spark that would track and damage the nearest enemy. The shock could be thrown at an opponent to stun and injure them, or could be set loose to track an opponent until it dissipates. The shock would not last more than five seconds or so before disappearing into a tiny burst of heat, but it was a useful technique for Sith apprentices. During his revolt against the New Jedi Order, Master [[Kenth Hamner|Hamner]] used this power to prevent his opponents from waking up in a timely manner after he defeated them.<ref name="Vortex" />

===Force storm===
'''Force storm''' was a Force lightning variant. The user would raise their palm upward and would create, through the Force, an explosion of electrical energy directed at all foes in the vicinity.<ref name="KotOR" /> This application of lightning should not be confused with the power to [[Force storm (weather)|conjure weather]] or [[Force storm (wormhole)|open a wormhole]], though they have similar names.

Unlike Force lightning, Force storm was not limited to attacking enemies in one direction, as it affected all foes within a certain radius from the user. Some notable practitioners of this power were [[Revan/Legends|Revan]],<ref name="KotOR" /> [[Darth Nyriss]], the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]],<ref name="Revan" /> [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]],<ref name="PoD">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref> [[Galen Marek]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]],<ref name="TFU" /> and Darth Krayt.<ref name="Legacy 32">[[Legacy (2006) 32|''Legacy'' (2006) 32]]</ref>

===Force Tempest===
[[File:Force_Tempest_TSS.png|thumb|left|200px|A Twi'lek darksider using Force Tempest]]
Force Tempest was a variant in which the user could project Force lightning from all of their limbs in a whirlwind that encircled their body. It could be used to inflict damage to multiple adversaries.<ref name="TSS">{{SWGTCG|set=The Shadow Syndicate|cardname=Force Tempest}}</ref>

===Chain lightning===
'''Chain lightning''' was a variation of Force lightning with the difference being that the lightning was able to strike one person and then move to another or several others. As it was more powerful than the standard lightning, it required a greater amount of discipline and concentration to project and sustain the stream of lightning. Some confirmed users are the Force apparition known as [[Dark Mara]], Galen Marek, Darth Nox, and Count Dooku

===Sith barrage===
'''Sith barrage''' was a variant of Force lightning that allowed users to create a bolt of lightning up from the ground damaging anything in its way.

===Lightning Shield===
'''Lightning Shield''' was another variation of Force lightning in which a shield of lightning covered and protected the user. Its effects could extend beyond the immediate space near the user, and could shock enemies in the distance. It could lower damage taken by the user, and could also enhance the saber damage the user dealt out. Some could use this power to float above the ground.<ref name="TFU" /> Sometimes this style of lightning was used to hold off an attacker that the Force-user wished to speak with during combat.<ref name="Legacy War 6" /> It was not the most powerful form of Force lightning, however; it still took mastery in the art of Force lightning and high concentration to use Lightning Shield. It could even redirect Force lightning back at another user of Force lightning. Some known users were Emperor Palpatine, Galen Marek,<ref name="TFU" /> Darth Krayt,<ref name="Legacy 32" /><ref name="Legacy War 6">[[Legacy — War 6|''Legacy — War'' 6]]</ref>, Darth Nox, Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa Solo.<ref name="Crucible" />

===Lightning Grenade===
'''Lightning Grenade''' was a Force lightning variation in which the user gripped an opponent or object with the Force and lifted them up into the air. While the victim was suspended the user blasted them with a brief burst of lightning. The practitioner then either dropped the victim or slammed them into an object, causing the lightning coursing within them to explode. Galen Marek and Darth Sidious were the only known practitioners.<ref name="TFU" />

===Lightning Bomb===
'''Lightning Bomb''' was a powerful variation of Force lightning. The Force user blasted an opponent with lightning, and then, using the Force, caused the lightning to amplify within the victim's body until it reached a critical point and exploded out of the victim. The explosion would also shock and kill anyone unlucky enough to be standing near the victim when the explosion occurred.

===Sith Seeker===
'''Sith Seeker''' was a very uncontrollable form of [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force push|Force push]]. The Force user blasted the target with Force push, sending the object through the air. The user then generated a large ball of Force lightning. The Force user allowed the lightning to expand freely until it was no longer under his or her control. They would then blast the Force lightning ball after the target, hence "Sith Seeker". The lightning exploded on impact with an opponent or object. The only known practitioner of Sith Seeker was [[Galen Marek]].<ref name="TFU" />

===Lightning Burst===
'''Lightning burst''' was a variant of Force lightning, where the user would have lightning arc out from their body to strike adjacent enemies.<ref name="Legacy Era Campaign Guide">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

===Vader's variant===
This was a particular variant of Force lightning, utilized as an alternative for Vader, who was unable to generate it normally. He could summon Force lightning from directly above an opponent, and then directing it from a storm he generates with the Force.<ref name="Star Wars: Star Wars: Masters of Teräs Käsi">''[[Star Wars: Masters of Teräs Käsi]]''</ref>

==Colors==
While most Force Lightning manifested itself as blue ([[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] (before [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|duel on Mustafar]] and obtaining [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|armor]])<ref name="RofSvg">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' video game]]</ref>, [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]]<ref name="AOTC" />), it could appear in several hues. For example, [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] and [[Darth Nox]] had all used purple lightning. [[Koro Ziil|The Hidden One]] used white. [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]], [[Mother (Rakatan entity)|Mother]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] were seen using green. Dark side users like [[Darth Desolous]], [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]],<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I: The Phantom Menace (video game)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref> [[Tenebrae]] and the [[Son/Legends|Son]], were seen wielding red. [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] also used a highly unusual color variant, in the form of black.<ref name="Dark Journey" /> Force users of the [[Eternal Empire]] used a form of yellow/orange lightning.<ref name="Dark Journey">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey]]''</ref> Leia Organa Solo and Luke Skywalker also made use of golden lightning.<ref name=":0" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the MMORPG ''Star Wars: Galaxies'', if a player of the Imperial faction attempted to contact Emperor Palpatine via hologram upon completing the Avenging Mort mission, Palpatine's hologram will use Force Lightning on the player to cover up his involvement.

[[George Lucas]] originally had the idea of Force lightning being a Jedi power to be introduced in ''The Empire Strikes Back''. Luke Skywalker and Darth Vader were to use it against each other in this idea of ''Empire Strikes Back'', with Luke's Jedi lightning being blocked by Vader (who also could use lightning in this concept) and when Vader crushed his powers, Luke would seem to almost fall to the dark side to increase his power when Vader's said that was the only way to beat him, but ultimately being defeated<ref name="The Making of The Empire Strikes Back">''[[The Making of The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> as in the actual film, though ultimately this idea of Luke blasting out lightning so early in his life was not shown in ''The Empire Strikes Back''.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back">{{Film|V}}</ref> The ''Return of the Jedi'' draft script also had an idea of Obi-Wan Kenobi and Yoda as ghosts manifesting to block the Emperor's use of Force lightning against Luke, shielding the young Jedi.<ref name="Rewind of the Jedi">{{InsiderCite|218|Rewind of the Jedi}}</ref>
